architecture.summary: SO-03 adds the tenant role of the hosted image: THERMUS_ROLE=tenant composes /healthz and /mcp only for TENANT_ORGANIZATION_ID, holds no secret, and refuses to start with a secret of the control plane (WORKOS_API_KEY, WORKOS_CLIENT_SECRET, WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD, GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY, DATABASE_URL, LOGGING_DESTINATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY, RENDER_API_KEY, STRIPE_*); no THERMUS_ROLE keeps the control plane of today. New container: the tenant server, the same image in the tenant role. New cross-container contract: the Thermus-Access header, an EdDSA JWT (typ thermus-access+jwt) with iss (authority), sub, aud (organization), iat, exp (2 minutes), grants, tokenHash (SHA-256 of the bearer token, base64url), and an optional name, verified with the Ed25519 public keys of GATEWAY_PUBLIC_KEY; a request without a verified context gets 403 before MCP handling, then the bearer check of today, the grants of the context through ContextAccessResolver, and no WorkOS membership read. New relay contract: the audit-logs relay sink posts each event to <CONTROL_PLANE_INTERNAL_URL>/internal/audit with the context of its request, with the bounds of the audit collector, best effort. The gateway and the /internal/audit route stay planned (SO-05). Component changes: identity signs and verifies the context with jose and node:crypto (signed-access-context.ts becomes a public module); audit-logs gains the relay and a runtime edge to identity; app -> identity becomes runtime; MCPServer.fetch takes a request scope; workos splits out WorkOSTokenVerifier; config reads THERMUS_ROLE and the tenant settings (declaration snapshot of deployment-config.ts). OPERATION_CAPACITY applies in both roles (default 10; the provisioner sets 5 free, 10 team). Measured on disposable Render services: CONTROL_PLANE_INTERNAL_URL is http://<slug of the control plane>:8080.
